newsitem.title: CHINA: China to issue commemorative coins for HK handover.
newsitem.headline: China to issue commemorative coins for HK handover.

text.p: China's central bank will on July 1 issue a commemorative series of four gold and silver coins to mark the return of the British colony of Hong Kong to Chinese rule, the China Daily said on Saturday.
The People's Bank of China, the central bank, will also issue 20 million coins for circulation to commemorate the handover, which takes place at midnight on June 30, the newspaper said.
The coins for circulation have a face value of 10 yuan ($1.20) and can be substituted for the existing 10 yuan banknote, it said.

The gold and silver coins -- the third series of Hong Kong coins the bank has issued since 1995 -- comprise two gold coins and two silver coins, China Daily said. The People's Bank issued similar sets of coins on December 1, 1995, and July 1, 1996, it said.
